title: Twenty thousand licences, honestly measured.
summary: 26 minutes a day on average; 17% saw no saving; adoption peaked at 83%.

spec.problem: Drafting, summarizing and record updates across 12 organizations. No baseline beyond self-report.
spec.changed: 20,000 Microsoft 365 Copilot licences for three months with change management and training.
spec.systems: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint.
spec.measured: Self-reported daily time saved from 7,115 responses, adoption rate, satisfaction. No control group.
spec.result: **26 minutes a day on average; 17% saw no saving; adoption peaked at 83%.** The report says it could not identify how the saved time was used. Government-authored, June 2025.[^27]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
